|DMG, Ailment
|Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealingPhysical DMG once, with a 40% base chance to inflictStun for 1 turn.

|Heart of Challenge
|DMG, Ailment
|Deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within 3 gridsof the caster, with an 85% chance to inflict Tauntfor 1 turn. Has a 100% chance to inflict Taunt non-character units. (Casts once at the start of battle.)
